violation_type.title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §746.5305)
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation has a fire extinguisher in the front room that is not securely mounted.

finding_variants.text: The operation has a fire extinguisher in the front room that is not securely mounted.
A fire extinguisher was found in a 3 year old classroom that was not mounted and placed over 5 feet off the floor on top of a cubby.
The fire extinguisher in the Preschool classroom was seen in plain view on a countertop and not mounted.
One fire extinguisher in the toddler room, and one fire extinguisher located in the kitchen were observed to not be mounted.
A fire extinguisher was observed unmounted in the infant classroom.    Note: A photo was taken.
One of the fire extinguishers in the hallway was observed on the floor. The bracket on the wall is broken.
